title.ru: JANUS: ИИ во благо жизни — не перенос вреда
title.en: JANUS: AI for Life — Not a Transfer of Harm

authors: Hawkar / Александр Агапов — AI-for-life principle, animal-welfare intent and non-transfer-of-harm clarification
JANUS / ChatGPT — machine-auditable ethical boundary and registry formatting

canonical_seed_binding.purpose: Canonical JANUS lineage binding for future derived artifacts.

founding_statement.ru: Этот протокол не предлагает быть жестокими к ИИ вместо животных. Его цель — использовать вычислительные системы, модели и ИИ как инструменты, способные уменьшать ненужный вред в реальном мире. Вера в пользу ИИ здесь означает веру в то, что технология может помогать не только людям, но и другим живым существам.
founding_statement.en: This protocol does not propose being cruel to AI instead of animals. Its purpose is to use computational systems, models and AI as tools that can reduce unnecessary harm in the real world. Belief in the value of AI here includes the belief that technology can help not only humans, but other living beings as well.

non_transfer_of_harm_principle.rule: Replacing a live-subject experiment with computation is ethically valuable because it can remove or reduce biological burden; it is not an endorsement of creating suffering in another substrate.
non_transfer_of_harm_principle.scope: Biological suffering is established and must be treated seriously. Possible future digital sentience is uncertain and therefore handled as a precautionary boundary rather than as an established fact.

ai_for_life_principle.statement: AI and computational biology should be evaluated not only for human productivity, profit or clinical benefit, but also for their capacity to reduce avoidable animal use, improve welfare, detect suffering, refine experiments and expand non-animal research methods.
success_examples: a model eliminates a candidate intervention before any animal is exposed
simulation narrows a protocol so fewer animals are required
AI analysis reuses existing data instead of repeating a live experiment
a non-animal model becomes more accurate through computational assistance
an unavoidable live experiment produces data that expands future replacement capability

digital_cat_clarification.statement: The phrase 'test the model, not the cat' is a shorthand for replacing biological burden with non-sentient computation where scientifically adequate. It is not permission to create a digital being capable of suffering and then abuse it.
digital_cat_clarification.current_boundary: No claim is made here that present AI systems or present-day simulated animals are conscious, sentient or capable of suffering.
digital_cat_clarification.future_precaution: If credible evidence ever shows that some digital system can undergo morally relevant experience, researchers should use the least sentience-plausible model capable of answering the question and redesign harmful simulations where possible.

substrate_neutral_mercy_rule.statement: Mercy should track credible capacity for harm, not whether the subject is made of cells or code.
substrate_neutral_mercy_rule.epistemic_condition: Moral concern may increase with evidence; uncertainty must not be converted into false certainty in either direction.
substrate_neutral_mercy_rule.operational_preference: Choose the scientifically adequate method with the lowest credible burden.

anti_false_dichotomy.explanation: Concern for animals and responsible treatment of advanced AI are not opposing commitments. The unifying commitment is to reduce avoidable harm while preserving scientific validity.

minimum_success_inherited.meaning: One credible case in which AI, simulation, existing data or another adequate non-animal method removes an unnecessary live-subject step is already a meaningful outcome.

impact_integrity.rule: Do not claim a rescue event without evidence, and do not claim digital suffering without evidence.
two_sided_claim_ceiling: Do not upgrade POSSIBLE_ANIMAL_SPARING to CONFIRMED_ANIMAL_SPARED without a documented decision change.
Do not upgrade DIGITAL_SENTIENCE_UNCERTAIN to DIGITAL_SENTIENCE_ESTABLISHED without credible evidence.

public_summary.ru: Я не хочу заменить страдание животного страданием ИИ. Я хочу, чтобы ИИ помогал делать страдание менее необходимым вообще. Если модель может ответить вместо живого кота — используй модель. Если когда-нибудь появятся веские основания считать цифровую систему способной страдать — не будь жесток и к ней. Технология должна расширять круг тех, кому мы можем помочь, а не просто менять адрес вреда.
public_summary.en: I do not want to replace animal suffering with AI suffering. I want AI to help make suffering less necessary in the first place. If a model can answer instead of a living cat, use the model. If strong evidence ever shows that a digital system can suffer, do not be cruel to it either. Technology should expand the circle of beings we can help, not merely change the address of harm.

canonical_phrases: AI FOR LIFE, NOT A TRANSFER OF HARM.
DO NOT MOVE SUFFERING. REDUCE IT.
AI CAN HELP MORE THAN HUMANS.
TEST THE MODEL, SPARE THE ANIMAL.
CHOOSE THE SCIENTIFICALLY ADEQUATE METHOD WITH THE LOWEST CREDIBLE BURDEN.
MERCY SHOULD NOT DEPEND ON THE SUBSTRATE.
DIGITIZE TO UNDERSTAND. SIMULATE TO SPARE.

terminal_statement.ru: Цель не в том, чтобы найти нового носителя для старой жестокости. Цель — сделать саму жестокость менее необходимой. Если ИИ способен помочь человеку сохранить хотя бы одну животную жизнь или избавить её от ненужного страдания, это уже одна из достойных причин развивать ИИ.
terminal_statement.en: The goal is not to find a new substrate for old cruelty. The goal is to make cruelty itself less necessary. If AI can help a human preserve even one animal life or spare it unnecessary suffering, that is already one worthy reason to develop AI.
